text:
nina: Quick heads-up: we're launching On‑Prem Export Safeguards for Private clusters today. Purpose: prevent accidental telemetry/PII export and give customers verifiable controls. Docs & rollout below.

raj: Nice. What safeguards are included?

nina: Three main controls: 1) export gate (manual approval + approver audit trail), 2) payload scrub profiles (configurable rulesets), 3) export-attestation (signed manifest). Default: export gate enabled, scrub profile = minimal.

compliance-bot: [NOTE] Controls mapped to SOC evidence types. Legal validated approved modes for EU data residency scenarios.

support-lead: For support ops: when customers enable export gate, any export requests will create a ticket with approver flow. Use label "lab:export-gate".

infra-eng: Deployment plan: canary Private clusters now, broad rollout in 5 days. Feature is opt-in per-cluster.

raj: Storage/ops impact?

nina: Minimal. Scrubbed exports are compressed; estimate ~1% storage uplift. Approver logs kept for 365 days by default.

deploy-bot: [RELEASE] onprem-export-safeguards v1.0 deployed to canary at 3276543230.

nina: Docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/private/export-safeguards (internal). We'll hold a 30-min demo tomorrow 09:30 PT. Ping me to join.

support-lead: We'll prep the support playbook and a CS checklist for customers who need help enabling this.

nina: Thanks — I'll post daily metrics for first 72h: export-requests, approvals-rate, scrub-failures.
